next.reason: 1985: 'INPUT file-name-1 [ REVERSED | WITH NO REWIND ] …'; 2023: '{ file-name-1 [ WITH NO REWIND ] } … (no REVERSED phrase; sharing-phrase and retry-phrase added)'. The 2023 OPEN format keeps the four modes and NO REWIND for INPUT/OUTPUT only, but drops REVERSED, so OPEN INPUT f REVERSED is refused. It also adds the SHARING and RETRY phrases.
